title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theater on 1981-09-12
lineage: Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > Panasonic SV 3700 DAT (A/D conversion)(HP data cartridge) > Apple G4 (RME interface)(Peak 5 editing) > Xact
source: 2 Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(TDK SA-X 90, Maxell UDXL-II 90 'Estimated thru Baby Bloe')

ai_review.summary: Warm, balanced soundboard capture of a stellar Greek Theatre show highlighted by scorching Fire solos and an unforgettable It’s All Over Now Baby Blue encore.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this Nakomi 300‑derived source delivers crystal‑clear warmth and balance, making it one of the best‑sounding versions of the concert. The performance is lauded as a year‑best show with standout Fire solos, numerous Jerry Garcia moments, and an exceptional setlist capped by a soaring It’s All Over Now Baby Blue encore.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers give 5‑star ratings, praising both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; the weighting favours a superb show plus excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warmth, balance, and clarity noted; described as less fatiguing and the clearest sounding source among multiple releases.

standout_songs: It’s All Over Now Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: Exceptional set list with a brilliant encore and even a second encore, creating a memorable Saturday night atmosphere.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight great Jerry moments and solos throughout the show.
